name: Day-old chicks
title: Day-old chicks: broiler and layer strains
description: Vaccinated Ross 308 and Cobb 500 broiler chicks and Hy-Line Brown and Lohmann Brown layer chicks, delivered with a brooding plan and 14 days of WhatsApp support.
summary: Broiler and layer chicks, vaccinated and graded for even weights.
alt: Hundreds of day-old chicks under red brooder lamps, with feeders and drinkers spread across the floor.
lede: Chicks hatched, vaccinated and graded for uniformity, then delivered to your farm with a brooding plan written for Zimbabwean conditions.
intro: Whether you are starting with 200 birds or scaling to 10,000, every batch comes from a biosecure hatchery and travels in sanitised, sealed crates under monitored conditions.

lists.heading: What comes with your chicks
items: A pre-delivery checklist covering litter, temperatures, drinkers and backup power.
A brooding starter pack with feed, vitamins and disinfectant.
Help on delivery day to record starting weights.
A simple way to track daily mortality, water and feed intake.

lists.heading: What farmers can expect
items: Mortality below 1.5% when the brooding guide is followed.
Even chick weights, so the whole batch starts eating quickly.
Delivery dates that match when your house is ready.

name: Broilers
title: Broilers: growers and finishers
description: Broiler growers and finishers bred for even growth and feed efficiency, with 35–42 day cycles, 1.8–2.2 kg live weight targets and veterinary support.
summary: Meat birds for 35–42 day cycles, with feed and health plans.
alt: White broiler chickens in an open-sided poultry house with hanging feeders.
lede: Broilers bred for even growth and good feed conversion, so your batch reaches market weight together.
intro: We manage feed, health and housing conditions from the breeder flock to your farm gate. Each delivery comes with production benchmarks so you can track your batch against the target, week by week.

lists.heading: What we offer
items: Growers and finishers delivered from 3 to 6 weeks old.
Contract growing for abattoirs and retailers.
Feed and medication bundles priced for the full cycle.
On-farm weighing and grading.
Vet call-outs for diagnosis and treatment.

lists.heading: Selling your birds
lists.text: We help line up your finish date with abattoir slots, wholesale buyers and cold storage, so birds leave your farm at peak value. You also get feed price updates, seasonal vaccination changes and labour schedules.

name: Layers
title: Layers: pullets and point-of-lay hens
description: Layer pullets and point-of-lay hens with full vaccination history, plus feed phase charts, lighting programmes and egg production tracking.
summary: Pullets and point-of-lay hens with full vaccination records.
alt: A close group of brown laying hens on grass.
lede: Pullets and point-of-lay hens selected for steady egg size, strong shells and long, flat production curves.
intro: Each flock comes with feed phase charts, a lighting programme and a vaccination schedule, whether you run cages, deep litter or free range.

lists.heading: What we offer
items: Layer feed blends, calcium boosters and vitamin packs.
Nest and perch layouts sized to your flock.
Egg collection routines that cut breakages and contamination.
Lighting programmes for open-sided and closed houses.

lists.heading: Keeping production steady
items: Tracking of hen-day percentage and egg mass.
Vet diagnosis for coccidiosis, infectious bronchitis and other layer diseases.
Flock sizing matched to local wholesale and retail egg demand.

name: Guinea fowl, turkeys and ducks
title: Guinea fowl, turkeys and ducks
description: Guinea fowl keets, broad-breasted turkeys and Pekin and Muscovy ducks for niche, festive and hospitality markets, with nutrition and vaccination plans.
summary: Birds for festive orders, hotels and other higher-value markets.
alt: A guinea fowl in a yard with white ducks and geese behind it.
lede: Hardy birds for higher-value markets: hotels, festive season orders and community protein schemes.
intro: Each programme comes with biosecurity support, a nutrition guide and a vaccination plan that works for mixed-species setups.

facts.label: Turkeys
facts.value: Broad-breasted white and bronze, poults or growers

groups.name: Guinea fowl
groups.text: Disease-resistant birds with lean meat that settle quickly into free range. You get housing designs that limit flight, a high-protein starter feed plan and advice on keeping predators out.

groups.name: Turkeys
groups.text: Poults or growers, fed on a schedule that reaches 6–8 kg dressed weight in time for holiday orders. Vaccination covers fowl pox and Newcastle disease.

groups.name: Ducks
groups.text: Meat and eggs from the same flock. We advise on pond or trough water, litter and breeding rotations so production keeps going all year.

lists.heading: Help with selling
items: Cold chain and slaughter guides for seasonal turkey sales.
Packaging ideas for premium markets.
Contract farming with hotels and retailers.
Record sheets for mixed-species flocks.

name: Rabbits
title: Rabbits: breeding trios and grow-out stock
description: New Zealand White, California and Chinchilla rabbits as breeding trios or grow-out stock, with housing designs, breeding calendars and feed plans.
summary: Breeding trios and grow-out stock, with breeding calendars.
alt: A young grey rabbit eating fresh grass.
lede: Fast-breeding meat rabbits that do well on local forage, for backyard projects through to commercial units.
intro: We supply breeding trios and grow-out stock, and help you choose a housing system that fits your space and budget.

lists.heading: What comes with your rabbits
items: Housing designs for battery, hutch and deep litter systems.
Breeding calendars, kindling management and record sheets.
Feed plans built on local forage and pellets.

lists.heading: Selling your rabbits
lists.text: We connect farmers with butcheries, restaurants and other buyers looking for rabbit meat, and help with grading, cold chain planning and contracts for repeat orders.

name: Goats
title: Goats: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona
description: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona goats for meat and breeding, with pasture rotation guides, health protocols and kid nutrition plans.
summary: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona goats for meat and breeding.
alt: A small herd of spotted brown and white goats walking across dry grassland.
lede: Hardy meat and breeding goats suited to Zimbabwean grazing, for semi-intensive and free-range systems.
intro: We help you select a breeding herd and plan housing, grazing and cash flow for the years it takes to build it.

lists.heading: What comes with your goats
items: Housing designs with pasture rotation guides.
Health protocols for deworming, dipping and vaccination.
Breeding herd selection and kid nutrition plans.

lists.heading: Selling your goats
lists.text: We introduce farmers to butcheries, restaurants and export buyers, and help with carcass standards, cold chain planning and contracts for repeat orders.
